channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Extended pause guidance – UOB
item.description: UOB Global Economics & Markets Research notes that the Federal Reserve is widely expected to keep the Federal Funds Target Rate at 3.50%-3.75% at the July FOMC meeting.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: BoC minutes watched for inflation tone – TD Securities
item.description: TD Securities strategists expect the Bank of Canada’s (BoC) Summary of Deliberations to shed light on the July decision, focusing on how policymakers view inflation amid recent energy price moves and Consumer Price Index (CPI) forecast revisions.

item.title: Indian Rupee rally takes a timeout as oil price rebounds
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) trades marginally lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday after a three-day winning streak. The USD/INR pair rebounds to near 95.85, the intraday high, as oil prices have rebounded strongly due to revived geopolitical risks.

item.title: Euro: Seen back toward 1.15 against US Dollar – ING
item.description: ING’s Francesco Pesole notes that EUR/USD may have bottomed last week if markets maintain a constructive view on further geopolitical de-escalation. He argues a sustained move above 1.15 still requires dovish Federal Reserve (Fed) repricing and stabilised risk sentiment.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Policy gap favours further losses against Euro – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman reports that the Swiss Franc (CHF) continues to weaken versus the Euro, with EUR/CHF reaching new highs as widening yield differentials favour the Euro.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Wednesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $57.92 per troy ounce, up 1.36% from the $57.14 it cost on Tuesday.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Near-term bias remains bearish ahead of Fed-BoE policy
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is marginally higher at around 1.3300 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Wednesday. The GBP/USD pair edges up as the US Dollar ticks lower ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Dow Jones futures gain ahead of Fed policy decision
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain 0.11% to trade around 53,000 during European trading hours on Wednesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures rise 0.16% to trade near 7,480, though Nasdaq 100 futures decline 0.17%, trading near 27,870, respectively.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Softer inflation supports RBA pause – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur notes that weaker-than-expected Australian inflation has sharply reduced market-implied odds of an August RBA rate hike and pushed the AUD lower.

item.title: ECB’s Patsalides: If higher oil prices persist, inflation risks rise
item.description: The remarks from European Central Bank (ECB) policymaker and Governor of the Central Bank of Cyprus, Christodoulos Patsalides, released during the European trading session on Wednesday signal a warning of further acceleration in inflationary pressures if oil prices remain higher.

item.title: Gold stalls intraday recovery near of $4,050 as traders keenly await FOMC decision
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on its intraday recovery from an over one-week low and trades below the $4,050 level through the first half of the European session on Wednesday.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Surprise risk keeps global rates elevated – ING
item.description: ING’s Michiel Tukker expects the Federal Reserve (Fed) to keep rates on hold, even as markets price a 30% chance of a hike.

item.title: Swiss Franc remains depressed despite brightening ZEW Economic Expectations
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) holds gains near 13-month highs against the Swiss Franc (CHF), with the USD/CHF pair trading a few pips shy of 0.8200, set for a 1.3% monthly rally.

item.title: Equities: Record allocation sustains Dollar exposure – BNY
item.description: Geoff Yu at BNY reports that global equity allocations have reached a record share of portfolios, with United States (US) markets dominating both equity and fixed-income holdings.

item.title: Australian Dollar: Softer inflation tempers rate hike odds – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes that the Australian Dollar, a beneficiary of AI-related demand, has weakened after another softer-than-expected Australian Consumer Price Index (CPI) release.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gains as oil prices rebound
item.description: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.4090 during the European hours on Wednesday.

item.title: US Dollar: Long positioning faces FOMC risk – DBS
item.description: DBS Bank’s Philip Wee notes that Dollar bulls have built substantial long USD positions ahead of the FOMC, encouraged by Brent’s sharp rebound and expectations of a surprise rate hike by Chairman Kevin Warsh.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD returns above $58.00 as US Dollar weakens
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) shows a moderate bullish tone on Wednesday, following a two-day reversal, with price action returning to levels above the $58.00 line at the early European trading session.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Likely remain subdued as Fed’s policy decision awaited
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades marginally lower in the European trade on Wednesday, reflecting caution ahead of the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) monetary policy announcement at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Federal Reserve: Poised decision keeps markets on edge – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s US economists expect the Federal Reserve to leave rates unchanged at a highly uncertain FOMC meeting, with markets pricing a significant chance of a hike.

item.title: WTI trades near $81.00 after rebounding amid supply fears mount
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price gains ground after three days of losses, trading around $81.00 per barrel during the European hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Oil: Persian Gulf risks support prices – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note Brent rebounded over 4% after recent losses as renewed attacks on US troops and Saudi energy infrastructure undermine prospects for a US–Iran deal.

item.title: Forex Today: Mood sours as Mideast conflict widens, focus shifts to Fed
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Wednesday, July 29:

item.title: Euro: Softer Fed signals may lift EUR against US Dollar – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Antje Praefcke argues that the FOMC under Chair Kevin Warsh is likely to deliver a "hawkish hold", with markets already pricing at least one Fed rate hike by year-end.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Hedging demand rises on bond gains – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu highlights that INR faces strong selling pressure from a rebalancing perspective, as Indian bonds have outperformed major peers. With INR flows broadly flat, FX exposure has risen and investors are advised to keep hedging elevated after strong duration gains.

item.title: US Dollar: Hawkish Fed hold may support USD – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan expects the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) to deliver a hawkish hold, with the Federal Reserve (Fed) keeping rates unchanged while stressing elevated inflation risks. He notes softer recent US data but highlights that markets still price some probability of a July hike.

item.title: Iraqi PM calls for urgent security meeting after Saudi-US strikes
item.description: Iraqi Prime Minister (PM) Ali Faleh al-Zaydi has called for an urgent security meeting on Wednesday following a joint military operation from Saudi Arabia and the United States (US), according to a statement.

item.title: Equities: Record highs with tech under pressure – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank analysts note that lower oil prices and bond yields supported US equities, helping the equal-weighted S&P 500 reach a record high as investors rotated into defensive and non-tech sectors.

item.title: Japanese Yen recovery halts below 163.30 US Dollar with Fed’s decision on tap
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) has trimmed some losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, but USD/JPY dips have been capped above previous highs, in the 163.30 area so far.

item.title: Oil: Volatile on Iran conflict swings – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists report that Oil prices initially fell sharply as the United States (US) military campaign against Iran remained paused, with WTI dropping to USD 79.26 and Brent to USD 84.10.
